parameters.query:
-- Кнопка из группы Заказчика. resume: Беседа handoff → open, Заявка collecting или qualified
-- по обязательным полям. close: Заявка и Беседа closed (closed ставит только человек).
-- Чужая группа, неизвестная Заявка или уже нажатая кнопка ничего не меняют: статусы null.
with target as (
  select l.id as lead_id, v.id as conversation_id,
    array(select f from unnest(c.required_fields) f where nullif(btrim(to_jsonb(l) ->> f), '') is null) as missing
  from leads l
  join companies c on c.id = l.company_id
  join conversations v on v.id = l.conversation_id and v.company_id = l.company_id
  where l.id = $1::uuid and c.telegram_chat_id = $2
    and case $3::text when 'resume' then v.status = 'handoff' else v.status <> 'closed' end
),
conversation as (
  update conversations v set status = case $3::text when 'resume' then 'open' else 'closed' end
  from target
  where v.id = target.conversation_id
  returning v.status
),
lead as (
  update leads l set
    status = case when $3::text = 'close' then 'closed'
      when cardinality(target.missing) = 0 then 'qualified' else 'collecting' end,
    missing_fields = case when $3::text = 'close' then l.missing_fields else target.missing end
  from target
  where l.id = target.lead_id
  returning l.status
)
select (select status from conversation) as conversation_status, (select status from lead) as lead_status

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ callback_query_id: $('Parse button').item.json.callback_query_id, text: ({ open: 'Беседа возвращена Ассистенту', closed: 'Заявка закрыта' })[$json.conversation_status] ?? 'Кнопка устарела: Заявка уже обработана' }) }}
